summary:
EA-credentialed Chartered Accountant with 7+ years of hands-on US accounting experience
in CPA firm and US environments, managing 35+ clients simultaneously as a Supervisor.
Expert in multi-client bookkeeping, month-end close (US GAAP), US payroll, sales tax
compliance across 5+ states, 1099 reporting, and financial reconciliation. Proficient in
QuickBooks Online/Desktop, Sage Intact, Bill.com, and knowledge of US tax – Basics (1040 /
1065 / 1120). Proven remote team leader who cuts turnaround time, onboard new clients,
and delivers beyond expectations — built for US industry seeking high-trust, time zone-
aligned talent in India.

bullets: Month-End Close & Financial Reporting: "Managed month-end close for 35+ US clients simultaneously” - Exposure in month end close, journal entries, accruals, prepaid, amortization, reconciliations, variance analysis; Assisted in preparation of Management Reports for stakeholders. Handled accounts payable, accounts receivable, credit card reconciliations, fixed assets , depreciation, intercompany reconciliations, and loan/holdback tracking across multiple US CPA clients;

Payroll & Tax compliance:"Processed payroll for 25 employees across multiple states(Texas, California)” – Handled payroll processing, fillings of 940, 941, W2, Federal Taxes, Social Security, Medicare via TWC and EFTPS portal;

Sales Tax Compliance & 1099 Reporting – “Filed Sales Tax returns across 5 US states for 10+ clients” - Ensuring compliances and timely filing and preparation for US states (Texas, Ohio, Utah, Colorado, California, etc. Managed annual filing and reporting of 1099’s;

Team Leadership, Client Implementation, On boarding, Communication & Client Handling: “Supervised a team of 3 accountants, reducing turnaround time by 50%” – Hired, Trained, Supervised, developned new hires per client specific standards and assisting in day to day operations and supported effective communication.
Led client onboarding and knowledge transfers for new engagements; developed SOPs for recurring processes;

Analytics & Process Innovation: “Reduced AP discrepancies by 80% through dashboard implementation” - Collaborated with Data analytics team to develop dashboard on global scale to provide a comprehensive overview of the organization acounts payable;

Specialized Accounting Areas: Applied ASC 842 (Lease accounting), Real estate accounting principals (Investment Hold and Fix & Flip properties), Bitcoin Mining, Cost tracking and project accounting across diverse client portfolio;

US Tax Assistance & Financial Reconciliation: Ensures financials statements reconciles with US Tax returns forms 1120, 1065 , 1040 by making accurate and appropriate adjustments as per tax rreettuurrnnss.. Supported the tax team in preparing accurate annual financial statements with supporting evidence of transactions by applying ticking & Tying process, facilitating proper tax fillings for Forms 1120, 1040 and 1065 on annual basis;

Audit Coordination & Finalization: Liaison with auditors for getting the client books audited and finalization of accounts based on audit adjustments; Review of current processes and internal controls being followed in the organizations and suggesting and implementing improvements thereof;

Accounting & Financial Reporting: Proficient in maintaining statutory books of accounts, performing reconciliations, preparing consolidated reports. Skilled in journal entries, accruals, prepaid, and executing financial closures. Experienced in financial statement preparation, ROC filings, and e-filing of statutory returns;

Audit & Taxation: Exposure to statutory audits, tax audits, and internal audits of private limited companies; Hands-on experience in GST implementation, maintaining books as per GST norms, filing of returns, handling input GST, managing e-way bills, and ensuring timely payments. Regularly oversaw compliance workflows and ensured statutory adherence;
Payroll & ROC & Compliances: Managed payroll processing including salary computations, TDS and filing of PF, ESIC, and other returns and ROC fillings;
